$comment: version: 1.0.0; original author: Napolean; current maintainer: Pedro
title: Wi-Fi extension for SigMF-meta file.
description: The `wifi`namespace extension defines dynamic Wi-Fi burst parameters extending `annotations`.

annotations.description: The following names are specified in the `wifi` namespace and should be used in the `annotations` object:

items.$comment: In the .md version of this schema, all of the fields were 'required' ...

wifi:standard.description: Wireless standard of captured signal e.g. 802.11a/g.

wifi:frame_type_phy.description: Physical layer specification e.g. non-high throughput or very-high throughput.

wifi:start_time_s.description: Start time of RF burst (relative time to start time of main capture file).

wifi:stop_time_s.description: Stop time of RF burst (relative time to start time of main capture file).

wifi:MCS.description: Wi-Fi signal Modulation and Coding Scheme (MCS).

wifi:MAC_frame.description: Wi-Fi MAC frame data without CRC.

wifi:start_of_packet.description: Starting sample of captured Wi-Fi burst.

wifi:stop_of_packet.description: Stopping sample of captured Wi-Fi burst.

wifi:number_of_samples_in_packet.description: Number of downsampled IQ samples in Wi-Fi burst.
